messages:
Elena (CEO): Quick exec weekly check-in — three priority asks this week: 1) finalize Private GA launch checklist, 2) stabilize Dedicated SLA rollouts, 3) push another round of unit-cost wins (batching/kv cache). Please keep replies short. :sparkles:
Sam (VP Product): Noted. Product will lock GA feature list by Tue noon. I'll post acceptance criteria in the private-ga doc and tag leads. :white_check_mark:
Rachel (VP Eng): We'll gate any infra churn until after Wed. Rolling canaries for the Dedicated SLA work start tomorrow morning — targeting 25% traffic on canary tier. Load test scheduled tonight 22:30 PST.
Omar (Head SRE): Incident summary from last night: cache-tier node flapped at 02:14, produced ~3m error spike for some routed customers. Auto-failover succeeded, no data loss. Root cause looks like kernel OOM during a GC; still investigating. Postmortem draft up in #postmortems. Will add stronger healthchecks and restart limits.
Mike (Head of Finance): Quick metric: unit cost per 1k tokens down ~4% week-over-week after batching tweaks. However Dedicated capacity commitments are increasing short-term cash outlay — need final numbers for new pricing tiers by Fri.
DeployBot: deployment 2026.03.22-178 to prod succeeded — 12 hosts updated, rolling window 14m, 99.98% request success observed. Logs: `deploy id=2026-03-22-178 status=success hosts=12 window=14m`
Sam (VP Product): For QA: we need a short prompt set that covers latency-sensitive tails + privacy regressions. I'll pull one tonight and share link.
Elena (CEO): Two explicit asks for owners: @Sam finalize canary & GA checklist by Tue 12:00; @Omar publish emergency rollback steps and place them in Console docs (ops-runbooks section) by Wed EOD. We'll do a short Friday review (10:00 PST) to sign off.
Rachel (VP Eng): Ack. Canaries will be telemetry-first; will open a read-only dashboard for execs.
Omar (Head SRE): Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/cache-flap-303456 -- summary: transient OOM during routine mem reclaim; mitigations: cgroup memlimit, tuned GC flags, and improved warmup.
Mike (Head of Finance): FYI — finance will surface 3 pricing scenarios for Dedicated (base, preferred, enterprise) ahead of Friday review.
Elena (CEO): Appreciate the quick moves. No new hires to approve this week unless critical. If anyone sees risk to Private GA date, flag it here asap. :rocket: 
Sam (VP Product): Will flag any scope that threatens GA.
Rachel (VP Eng): Rolling canary is live (0 -> 5% -> 15%). Monitoring alerts are enabled. Ping me directly if you need access to the canary cluster. :thumbsup:
Omar (Head SRE): Noted. Will post final rollback doc link here when ready.
DeployBot: Canary traffic toggle: ON -> 15%.
Elena (CEO): Thanks team — short sync Friday 10:00 PST. If nothing else, happy weekend in advance.
